 Deal | 10K+ free GTA 6 Ultimate Edition game codes coming in livestream Twitch drops
 ⓘ Rockstar Games, Twitch Banner for Twitch free GTA 6 Ultimate Edition giveaway shown Twitch joined Kick and YouTube by announcing rewards to celebrate the GTA 6 release date. Livestream drops will give away thousands of free Ultimate Edition Xbox and PS5 codes. The TwitchCon 2026 bulletin also teased new badges and emotes for viewers. Adam Corsetti , Published 11/14/2026 🇩🇪 Deal Console Gaming Streaming 
 4 Reviews     ← exclude selected types     ← exclude selected tags 
 Rockstar ’s anticipated crime epic should drive hordes of players to streaming platforms . Revealed at TwitchCon 2026, daily drops will include free GTA 6 Ultimate Edition game codes. Starting on the November 19th release date and ending on November 30th, any livestream viewer can qualify. 
 Twitch didn’t specify how many digital codes it intends to hand out, although the company offered a hint on social media. Likely referring to a competing Kick giveaway , the site responded to a post with: “Who said only 10,000?” That suggests the event is even more generous than its rival’s.
 The TwitchCon announcement lacked details on how the random drops will work. Cosmetic items are usually the rewards, but the process could differ with free copies of GTA 6 Ultimate Edition. One scenario would require viewers to watch a streamer for a set amount of time to become eligible. Or the company may task broadcasters with distributing Xbox and PS5 redemptions at their discretion. 
 In addition to the code drops, Twitch has unveiled a collection of Grand Theft Auto badges and emotes. With multiple levels to strive for, viewers may need to subscribe to channels to earn their desired perk. Hype trains that encourage support are also being renamed to heist trains. 
 Other chances to win
 Meanwhile, Kick’s promotion is already underway ahead of the GTA 6 release date. Account holders must consume at least 180 minutes of livestreams, not necessarily featuring the Rockstar title. The Sunset Reward Case contains badges and emotes, or, for lucky recipients, a free game redemption. 
 YouTube has its own plans to commemorate the imminent GTA 6 launch . At midnight EST on November 19th, a 24-hour gameplay livestreams headlined by popular content creators begins. Digital gifts for YouTube live broadcasts include a GTA wanted-star animation.
